description: Flat per-individual metadata schema for a large multi-population human sequencing cohort studying disease susceptibility from saliva-derived DNA.

record_id.descr: Unique stable identifier for the individual record within the dataset; should be non-identifying and consistent across releases.

participant_study_id.descr: Study-specific participant identifier; may be pseudonymized. Example: P00012345.

age_at_enrollment_years.descr: Age of the participant at enrollment or sample collection, in years.

sex_at_birth.descr: Sex recorded at birth. Acceptable values: female, male, intersex, unknown.

ethnicity.descr: Self-reported ethnicity or ethnolinguistic group using study-defined categories or free text if needed.

population_group.descr: Population or ancestry grouping used in the study for analysis. Example values: European, African, East Asian, South Asian, Admixed American, Middle Eastern, Oceanian.

country_of_birth.descr: Country where the participant was born, if available.

country_of_residence.descr: Current country of residence at time of enrollment.

self_reported_ancestry.descr: Self-reported ancestry information, including one or more ancestral backgrounds if available.

family_history_disease.descr: Whether the participant reported a family history of the disease(s) under study.

primary_disease_status.descr: Primary disease status relevant to the study at enrollment. Example values: case, control, unaffected, unknown.

disease_diagnosis_name.descr: Name of the diagnosed disease or condition, if applicable. Prefer standardized disease terms when possible.

disease_diagnosis_date.descr: Date of clinical diagnosis or onset documentation, if available.

phenotype_description.descr: Free-text or standardized description of relevant clinical phenotype(s) used in analysis.

medication_exposure.descr: Relevant medication exposure at or near enrollment, if recorded.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at enrollment. Example values: never, former, current, unknown.

alcohol_use_status.descr: Alcohol use status or category, if collected.

height_cm.descr: Self-reported or measured height in centimeters, if available.

weight_kg.descr: Self-reported or measured weight in kilograms, if available.

bmi_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index in kg/m^2, calculated or measured.

blood_pressure_systolic_mmhg.descr: Systolic blood pressure in mmHg, if measured.

blood_pressure_diastolic_mmhg.descr: Diastolic blood pressure in mmHg, if measured.

collection_date.descr: Date the biospecimen or participant record was collected or enrolled.

consent_leaflet_version.descr: Version or identifier of the participant information leaflet/consent form used.

consent_type.descr: Consent model used. Example values: broad, tiered, study-specific, dynamic, withdrawn.

consent_for_genomic_analysis.descr: Whether the participant consented to genomic sequencing and downstream analysis.

consent_for_data_sharing.descr: Whether the participant consented to controlled or broad sharing of de-identified genomic data.

consent_for_future_research.descr: Whether the participant consented to use of their data/samples in future unspecified research.

withdrawal_date.descr: Date of consent withdrawal, if applicable.

biospecimen_type.descr: Type of biospecimen collected. For this study, expected value is saliva.

biospecimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the saliva or derived DNA sample.

sample_collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the saliva sample. Example values: passive drool, saliva collection kit, mouth rinse.

sample_collection_site.descr: Location or site where the sample was collected, if relevant.

sample_collection_time.descr: Time of day when sample collection occurred, if available.

sample_processing_date.descr: Date the biospecimen was processed in the laboratory.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition for the sample or extracted DNA. Example values: -20C, -80C, liquid nitrogen, room temperature.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol or kit used for saliva sample processing.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total extracted DNA yield in nanograms.

dna_quality_metric.descr: Primary DNA quality metric used by the study, such as A260/280 or DIN.

dna_quality_value.descr: Value of the DNA quality metric reported in dna_quality_metric.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used before sequencing.

library_type.descr: Library type, such as PCR-free, paired-end, mate-pair, or target-capture library.

target_enrichment_panel.descr: Target capture panel or gene panel name, if sequencing is targeted rather than whole-genome.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used. Example values: Illumina NovaSeq, Illumina HiSeq, BGI DNBSEQ, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_assay_type.descr: Sequencing assay type. Example values: whole-genome sequencing, exome sequencing, targeted sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run or library.

paired_end_reads.descr: Whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

sequencing_depth_x.descr: Approximate mean sequencing depth or coverage in fold (x).

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or lane, if applicable.

sequencing_center.descr: Name of the facility or center where sequencing was performed.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome build used for alignment and variant calling. Example values: GRCh37, GRCh38.

alignment_tool.descr: Primary aligner used for read mapping.

variant_calling_pipeline.descr: Pipeline or software used for variant detection and genotyping.

variant_calling_target.descr: Variant class or analysis target. Example values: common SNPs, indels, structural variants.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample/record passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_fail_reason.descr: Reason the record failed QC, if applicable.

genotype_missingness_rate.descr: Proportion of missing genotype calls for the record, if calculated.

contamination_estimate_pct.descr: Estimated sample contamination percentage, if assessed.

relatedness_flag.descr: Whether the sample was flagged as closely related to another participant in the cohort.

population_structure_cluster.descr: Cluster assignment from population structure or ancestry inference analysis, if available.

imputation_reference_panel.descr: Reference panel used for genotype imputation, if applicable.

imputation_info_score_mean.descr: Mean imputation quality score across analyzed variants, if applicable.

disease_risk_score.descr: Any computed genetic risk score or polygenic risk score for the participant, if included in the record.

disease_risk_score_scale.descr: Scale or standardization used for the disease risk score. Example values: raw, z-score, percentile.

returned_results_flag.descr: Whether individual research results or findings were returned to the participant, if policy allows.

data_use_restriction.descr: Restrictions on downstream use of the record. Example values: none, controlled access only, no commercial use, no international transfer.
